meta.title: Donkey Cut Video Editor — Free, Open Source CapCut Alternative
meta.description: A free, open source CapCut alternative. Edit with Chat, generate video, images, voiceovers and music, and keep your projects local.

hero.body: Edit with chat, generate images and video, and keep your files on your own computer. Use your existing Claude or Codex subscription if you already have one.

worksWith.title: Works <italic>with</italic>
worksWith.body: The assistant uses the Claude and Codex apps already signed in on your Mac. If you have a subscription, you’re done — no setup, no API keys.
